title: Agent Registry
hook: A governed org-wide catalog of agents, tools, skills, and MCP servers — with owners on record.

back.lead: As deployments scale from a handful of agents to hundreds, nobody knows what exists, who owns it, or whether it was approved. Agent Registry (preview via AgentCore) is a governed catalogue for discovering, sharing, and reusing agents, tools, skills, and MCP servers across an organization.

kv.v: Ownership, supported protocols, capabilities, and invocation details for each entry.
Shadow-agent sprawl is a governance risk more mundane than prompt injection — and arguably more dangerous.

back.hookline: The 'service catalog' moment for agents: if it's not in the registry, it doesn't officially exist.
